name: TrueWood American Walnut Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real American walnut veneer on the front and both edges, backed with black acoustic felt.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet was published; the recorded panel is 11.8 × 94.49 × 0.75 in, and photos suggest 7 slats per panel, estimated at 1.10 in face width with 0.586 in flat black-felt gaps on a 1.686 in pitch and slightly rounded edges. This tile spans 7 pitches × 23.6 in; walnut colors are sampled from the main listing photo, with procedural grain, and the estimated 0.49 in face-to-felt relief is separate from the recorded total depth.
